The Bright Side:
Enhanced cross-agency cooperation and fusion centers genuinely prevent modern threats.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis conflates structural technical fixes (WHO/HOW) with deep political accountability (WHY).

Social Physics Analysis:
Agencies shift from isolated silos to collaborative networks, yet political leadership occasionally weaponizes intelligence pretexts, repeating past systemic errors.

The Trajectory: The Path of Redemption.
When you map institutional adaptation against recurring political pressures, it plots a trajectory toward conditional equilibrium. Mathematical convergence balances reform against old flaws.

The Unavoidable Truth: Better intelligence sharing prevented numerous attacks since 2001.

The Unavoidable Lie: Institutional reorganizations entirely eliminate political pressure on intelligence.
